signals.title: Taylor Park, Zamdela, Sasolburg (approx.): DA ward 14 candidate Thulani Mbana shot dead at his home, 26 Oct
signals.content: Thulani Mbana, the DA's ward 14 candidate and Metsimaholo caucus leader, was shot dead at his home in Taylor Park, Zamdela, Sasolburg, at about 21:40 on Monday 26 October, according to police. Police say two unknown men approached his residence and called out to him; when he went to them, one produced a firearm and shot him several times at close range, and both fled on foot. He died at the scene. A murder case is being investigated; the provincial commissioner activated the Zamdela Trio Task Team and the Serious Organised Crime Unit. Police say the motive has not been established and it has not been confirmed whether the killing was politically motivated. No arrests were reported. Sources: SAPS Free State statement and OFM News (Brig Thandi Mbambo), 27 October, and SABC News, 27 October (DA statement). The map point is the Zamdela suburb point, not his home.

signals.title: Meqheleng, Ficksburg (approx.): Mophinia Molise, 49, found dead in a yard; man, 22, charged with murder and rape, 25 Oct
signals.content: The body of Mophinia Molise, 49, from Meqheleng near Ficksburg, was found lying in a yard near a house in Zone 2, Meqheleng, at about 08:00 on Sunday 25 October, according to police. Police say the body was covered with a blanket and she had a severe open wound to the throat; her husband, who had last seen her at a local tavern on Saturday night, found her. A 22-year-old man was arrested on Sunday evening and charged with murder and rape, and was due in the Ficksburg Magistrate's Court on 27 October; police say a post-mortem confirmed sexual assault and a case of rape and murder is being investigated. An arrest is not a conviction, and the accused is not named. One source, the SAPS Free State statement of 27 October. The date is when she was found; when she died is not given. The map point is the Meqheleng township point, not the yard.
